data.one_liner: Advanced logging framework that saves logs to a database and exports them in files or zip archives.
data.what_it_does: FLog is an advanced logging solution for Flutter that saves logs into a local database (sembast). It supports various log levels, custom formatting, encryption, stack traces, and data logs. Logs can be filtered, queried, printed as strings, or exported as zip archives.
use_when: You need to store app logs locally in a database for production debugging and user activity tracking.
You want to export filtered logs or zip files to share or upload to a server.
You need support for log levels, custom data logs, and exception formatting.
avoid_when: You only need standard console printing without local database storage or file exporting.
strengths: Saves logs to a database with robust filtering capabilities.
Supports log encryption and data log types.
Provides automatic or manual class/method name detection.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform permission configuration on Android and iOS.
Relies on several third-party dependencies (sembast, xxtea, intl, etc.).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding storage permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and photo library usage descriptions in iOS Info.plist.
